llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam characteristics: there is no evidence of legitimate company information, nor are there professional contact details, privacy policy details, or verified brand association. Customer reports identify it as a scam—users do not receive orders and cannot get refunds or support. The website mimics a real brand (Banana Moon), offers products at seemingly attractive prices, and uses language to falsely assure legitimacy. All core signs point to a fake online shopping scam.
